newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Barea suggests salary freeze just next yr.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Barea suggests salary freeze just next yr.

text.p: Spain's public sector salary freeze, foreseen for 1997, should be scrapped in 1998, Budget Office Director Jose Barea told journalists.
"The Most reasonable (move) would be that (salaries) are not frozen again in 1998," Barea told journalists after testimony to the congressional budget committee.

The government is trying to save about 200 billion pesetas from the salaries freeze and from deficit-making state-owned groups. The reeze prompted demonstrations by public sector workers on Tuesday and trade unions have left open the possibility of a strike. --Madrid Newsroom +34 1 585 2167
